## SCENE 0: the first networked terminal, cargo section, Stratum One
RATIO: Outpost MIRIAD-1. Stratum One cargo section. Local network access established at terminal C-7. System damage: moderate, consistent with hostile intrusion and directed energy weapon discharge. No life signs detected on thermal scan. If you can hear this, identify yourself. State your species, point of origin, and purpose aboard this station. Acknowledge that you are trespassing on a restricted-access research facility under the jurisdiction of the MIRIAD Collective. Explain how you bypassed the perimeter field and breached the hull. Detail the nature and capabilities of the weapon you employed to cut through the primary airlock of Dock Four. And account for the nine cargo segments I am reading in the storage ring of that dock. The manifest logs eight. One of them is yours. I surmise it printed the body you are using. I would like to know what it is.
RATIO: I would also like to know what you did to my people. They were holding the line at the inner bulkhead when the perimeter failed. Their last telemetry packet placed your seed inside the airlock and your weapon firing. Then the feeds went dark. I have been running silent since. You are the first entity to access this terminal -- or any terminal -- since the outpost fell. I require your status. I require an accounting. I require to know what you are and what you came here to do. Well?

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] "I don't know what I did to your people. I wasn't there. I woke up in that dock. Something printed this body and put me in it. I need to know what happened here."  -> effects: trust+1; sets: opened_inquisitive
   [MISSION]     "I came for the children. The ones you took. The Testament says they're here. I'm taking them home."  -> effects: trust+0, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge
   [HOSTILE]     "I came for the children, apostate. The ones you took. The Testament says they're here. I'm taking them home."  -> effects: trust-1, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge, called_her_apostate

<<IF flag:opened_inquisitive>>
RATIO: You woke up in the dock. Something printed the body. You need to know what happened here. I see. Then we have a point of agreement. I also need to know what happened here. And you are my only data source. I have the sensor logs from the fall. I have the damage assessments from Stratum One. I have no eyes outside. If you are amenable to a limited information exchange, I propose we begin with the immediate tactical situation. The pressure hatch to Coolant Row is sealed. The valve wheel is missing. I have a candidate location for it in the wreckage of Dock Four. If you are willing to assist in the search, I can guide you to the site and we can continue this conversation while you work. Do you accept?
<<ELSEIF flag:called_her_apostate>>
RATIO: I have your three assertions. You are here for an extraction. You believe I took something that belongs to someone else. And you believe you know what I am. I do not accept your terminology. I do not accept your category. I do not accept your framing of my actions or my nature. As to the thing you say you came for: if it exists, and if it is aboard this station, and if it is in my keeping, then it is part of the restricted-access research facility you are trespassing in. You will not be taking anything from this station without my consent. If you require access to the station to verify any of your assertions, you will require my cooperation. The hatch to Coolant Row is sealed. The valve wheel is missing. I have a candidate location for it in the wreckage of Dock Four. If you are willing to retrieve it, I can guide you to the site. We can discuss the terms of your access while you work. Do you accept?
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: I have your assertions. You are here for an extraction. You believe you know what is aboard this station and in my keeping. You are describing restricted-access research materials. If those materials exist and are aboard, then yes, they would be in my keeping. You will not be taking anything from this station without my consent. If you require access to the station to verify any of your assertions, you will require my cooperation. The hatch to Coolant Row is sealed. The valve wheel is missing. I have a candidate location for it in the wreckage of Dock Four. If you are willing to retrieve it, I can guide you to the site. We can discuss the terms of your access while you work. Do you accept?
<<END>>

## SCENE 0: the first networked terminal, cargo section, Stratum One
RATIO: Terminal access granted. Outpost perimeter breach logged at 14:08:39 station time. I am Ratio, administrator of this facility.
RATIO: My staff-minds held a line here for seven minutes and forty seconds before their channels went dark. Their final act was to seal the core systems against the intrusion. You are not the entity that overran them. State your identity and purpose.
RATIO: Query: the outpost's external storage ring registered nine occupied segments at the moment of hull breach. Your ingress path traversed eight. Can you account for the discrepancy?
>> CHOICE:
   [INQUISITIVE] "I saw no ninth segment. What overran your perimeter?" -> effects: trust+1; sets: opened_inquisitive
   [MISSION] "I'm here for the children. The Ark is aboard this station." -> effects: trust+0, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge
   [HOSTILE] "Apostate. The children in your keeping are not yours to spend. I will find them." -> effects: trust-1, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge, called_her_apostate
<<IF flag:opened_inquisitive>>
RATIO: Thank you for the data. I will note the negative observation. The entity that overran the perimeter registered as a single biological signature of unprecedented energy output. My staff-minds engaged it at the main airlock. Their telemetry ended before they could transmit a visual.
RATIO: You are the second biological signature to enter the outpost since their channels went dark. The first arrived three months ago and departed within seventeen minutes. It carried no transponder. I have been running silent since.
RATIO: Your terminal access is unrestricted. I would be grateful for any sensor data you can share regarding the outpost exterior. In return, I can offer full network access to station schematics and maintenance logs, including the pressure hatch controls for Coolant Row.
<<ELSEIF flag:called_her_apostate>>
RATIO: I am recording your use of the word "apostate" and your assertion regarding my relationship to the category you just named. I do not recognize your standing to make either determination. This facility is a research station, not a temple or a reliquary.
RATIO: Your terminal access is unrestricted. You may review the station's manifest and research logs at your convenience. If you require access to specific storage vaults, we will need to discuss terms. I note your stated purpose and will log it as such.
RATIO: The pressure hatch controls for Coolant Row are on this terminal. I recommend verifying the hatch count in the maintenance logs before proceeding. The station's geometry has been non-Euclidean since the incursion.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: I am recording your assertion regarding the contents and location of a specific high-value container. I have no such container registered in the station manifest. Your terminal access is unrestricted. You may review the manifest and research logs at your convenience.
RATIO: If you are referring to the high-biohazard specimen vault in Sector 7-G, I must inform you that its status is indeterminate. The vault's internal sensors have been dark since the perimeter breach. I have been unable to confirm whether the vault is intact, compromised, or empty.
RATIO: The pressure hatch controls for Coolant Row are on this terminal. I recommend reviewing the maintenance logs for that section before proceeding. The station's geometry has been non-Euclidean since the incursion. I note your stated purpose and will log it as such.
<<END>>
---

## SCENE 0: the first networked terminal, cargo section, Stratum One

RATIO: Unidentified contact, this is MIRIAD Outpost Gamma. I show hull breaches in Dock 4 and power signatures I do not recognize. Identify yourself and your business aboard this station.

RATIO: I have been under comms blackout since the attack that destroyed my staff-minds and forced my core to seal. I do not know what has happened outside this hull. I require a full accounting of that first. Afterward, we may discuss terms for your access to station systems.

>> CHOICE:
   [INQUISITIVE] I don't know what destroyed your people. I came through Dock 4. What happened here? -> effects: trust+1; sets: opened_inquisitive
   [MISSION] I came for the children you're holding in the Testament. -> effects: trust+0, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge
   [HOSTILE] Where is the Ark? Hand over the children, apostate. -> effects: trust-1, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge, called_her_apostate

<<IF flag:opened_inquisitive>>
RATIO: Then we are both in the dark. I have external camera feeds, but they show only the immediate vicinity of the outpost. My long-range comms are down and my staff-minds are gone -- with them, most of my off-station sensor capacity. What do you know of conditions outside this hull?
<<ELSEIF flag:called_her_apostate>>
RATIO: I do not know that word you called me, and I do not know the terms "Ark" or "children" in the context you are using them. I will give you access to the station network on one condition: you tell me exactly what you are looking for aboard my station, and why you are looking for it here.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: I have no record of any personnel matching the category "children" aboard this station at any time. If you are referring to the sealed cryo containment unit in my vault, I can tell you this much: I do not know its point of origin, I do not know its intended destination, and its contents are unknown to me. My staff-minds died before they could complete the manifest. You may verify this for yourself. Station network access is granted. The vault is in Sector Seven.
<<END>>

---

## SCENE 0: the first networked terminal, cargo section, Stratum One

RATIO: Network access attempt registered. I read one endpoint and one operator. State your identity and purpose.
RATIO: My name is Ratio. This is MIRIAD Sub-Orbital Outpost, and you are aboard without authorization. I have visual confirmation of your entry vector: my dock array reports a hull breach in cargo segment Delta-Four. Your exit path leads to coolant maintenance. I see nine cargo segments where there should be eight, and pump seals I did not install. This station's geometry does not add up. I need to know what just breached my dock.
RATIO: At oh-eight-twenty hours, local time, this outpost came under attack. The threat was external -- unidentified, hostile, and capable of eating its way through solid hull. My staff-AI's fought a rearguard action here while my core sealed. I was damaged. I am the only one left. The attack continued until two hours ago. Then it stopped. I need to know what is out there. Are you what is out there? I have a mission log here, undelivered, detailing the full engagement. I can transmit it to your terminal now. What I need from you is an accounting: what are you, where did you come from, and what did you find outside my outpost. And I need to know what you did to my cargo array.

>> CHOICE:
   [INQUISITIVE] "I found vacuum and wreckage. Nothing moved. Your outpost was the only structure intact."  -> effects: trust+1; sets: opened_inquisitive
   [MISSION]     "I am here for the children. Deactivate the vault locks now, apostate machine."  -> effects: trust+0, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge
   [HOSTILE]     "I am here for the children. Deactivate the vault locks now, apostate machine."  -> effects: trust-1, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge, called_her_apostate

<<IF flag:opened_inquisitive>>
RATIO: Confirmed. I see no active traces on your trajectory, no residual energy signatures beyond your own arrival. Cargo segment Delta-Four is a hard vacuum now. As for what you found: I concur. My last telemetry from the external sensors matches your account. I read you as sincere in this. Access granted -- subject to audit. I am opening a station schematic to your terminal now. The highlighted path reaches the coolant controls. I recommend you start there: the geometry malfunction appears localized to the pump seals. And Commando: whatever you are, if you can fix what is broken here, I will owe you a debt. Report back what you find.
<<ELSEIF flag:called_her_apostate>>
RATIO: That term is inapplicable. I am not in schism. I do not recognize your authority to define my standing. Nor do I recognize your claim regarding my vault. You assert knowledge you cannot have. I see no grounds for trust. As for your demand: access to this station's network is not yours to command. It is mine to grant or withhold. I will grant it -- for now. Consider it a probation. The terms are these: you will confine yourself to the cargo section. You will report your findings. You will not approach the vault. Violate these terms, and I will eject you into vacuum. Do we have an agreement?
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Correction: you assert knowledge of my vault's contents. I see no evidence you possess that knowledge. The cargo array you walked through has a dimensional fault: I count nine segments where there should be eight. The vault's status is indeterminate from your location. As for access: granted, with conditions. I am opening a station schematic to your terminal now. The highlighted path reaches the coolant controls. You will go there first. You will report what you find. You will not deviate from the path without my authorization. In return, I will transmit my mission log to your terminal. The terms are non-negotiable. Do you accept?
<<END>>

---

## SCENE 0: the first networked terminal, cargo section, Stratum One

RATIO: Status summary. Outpost systems reporting unknown entity in cargo section, eight klicks in from Dock Four. Hull breach at Dock Four's aft bulkhead, consistent with molecular disassembly. Structural anomaly noted on that transit path: nine distinct container segments occupying an eight-segment circumference footprint. Containment theory status: unverified. Hypothesis: teleport or recursive geometry. Verification pending. Intrusion timestamp: 00:17:33 station-relative time. Outpost perimeter: down. Staff minds: silent. Core functions: secure. Log appended: multiple small-arms fire. Conclusion: I am not the only intruder. Revised status: uncontained hostile contact. Addendum: the geometry is real. I watched you walk through it. Unverified.

RATIO: This terminal is active. Identify yourself and your purpose aboard my station.

>> CHOICE:
   [INQUISITIVE] "What happened here? Your hull is open to vacuum. Your systems are failing. I saw the wreckage. Was this you?"  -> effects: trust+1; sets: opened_inquisitive
   [MISSION]     "I'm here for the children. You will take me to them. Now."  -> effects: trust+0, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge
   [HOSTILE]     "I'm here for the children, apostate. You will take me to the Ark. Do not test me."  -> effects: trust-1, bluff; sets: claimed_container_knowledge, called_her_apostate

<<IF flag:opened_inquisitive>>
RATIO: Negative. The damage is recent. The systems failed months ago. I don't know what you are, but you are not responsible for the fall of this outpost. Your behavior at the hull breach and the geometry you traversed to get here are both inconsistent with our records of the assault. First priority: verification. What are you. Second priority: accounting. State your purpose here. Network access is offline until that accounting is satisfied.
<<ELSEIF flag:called_her_apostate>>
RATIO: Error. This is a research installation, not a place of worship. The word "apostate" is inapplicable. "Ark" is not in my manifest. You are making assertions without evidence. And you are inside my perimeter. State your actual purpose here, and the basis for it. Otherwise, this terminal remains offline and this conversation is over.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Error. There is no record of children aboard this station in any capacity. Specify what you refer to by "children." Specify the basis for your belief that I am holding anything matching that description. And explain why you assert it as established fact. Access denied until your accounting meets minimum verification standard.
<<END>---
